//===== rAthena Script =======================================
//= Supply Merchant (custom)
//===== Description: =========================================
//= Consumables by job. One price for everything; the items are given account-bound (they can be stored, not sold to an NPC).
//= Generated by srh_lite/tools/items/make_supply_shop.py
//============================================================

hero_ent3,69,128,4	script	Supply Merchant	858,{
	mes "[Supply Merchant]";
	mes "Everything you need to stay in the fight.";
	mes "What are you looking for?";
	next;
	switch (select("General Recovery:Cardinal:Dragon Knight:Casters - Gemstones & Points:Biolo:Mechanic:Ninja & Shinkirou:Guillotine Cross:Gunslinger & Night Watch:Spirit Handler & Soul Ascetic:Trouvere & Abyss Chaser:Windhawk - Arrows & Traps:Pride Catalysts:Cancel")) {
	case 1: close2; callshop "pg_sup_1",1; end;
	case 2: close2; callshop "pg_sup_2",1; end;
	case 3: close2; callshop "pg_sup_3",1; end;
	case 4: close2; callshop "pg_sup_4",1; end;
	case 5: close2; callshop "pg_sup_5",1; end;
	case 6: close2; callshop "pg_sup_6",1; end;
	case 7: close2; callshop "pg_sup_7",1; end;
	case 8: close2; callshop "pg_sup_8",1; end;
	case 9: close2; callshop "pg_sup_9",1; end;
	case 10: close2; callshop "pg_sup_10",1; end;
	case 11: close2; callshop "pg_sup_11",1; end;
	case 12: close2; callshop "pg_sup_12",1; end;
	case 13: close2; callshop "pg_sup_13",1; end;
	case 14: close;
	}
	end;

OnInit:
	.price = 1000;
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_1";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_2";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_3";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_4";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_5";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_6";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_7";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_8";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_9";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_10";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_11";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_12";
	npcshopattach "pg_sup_13";
	end;

// the shops hand the purchase to this label: the script decides the price and gives the items
OnBuyItem:
	.@kinds = getarraysize(@bought_nameid);
	.@n = 0;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@kinds; .@i++)
		.@n += @bought_quantity[.@i];
	.@cost = .@n * .price;
	if (Zeny < .@cost) {
		dispbottom "You do not have enough zeny (" + .@cost + " needed).";
		end;
	}
	if (checkweight2(@bought_nameid, @bought_quantity) == 0) {
		dispbottom "You can not carry that much weight.";
		end;
	}
	getinventorylist;
	if (250 - @inventorylist_count < .@kinds) {
		dispbottom "Your inventory is full.";
		end;
	}
	Zeny -= .@cost;
	for (.@i = 0; .@i < .@kinds; .@i++)
		getitembound @bought_nameid[.@i], @bought_quantity[.@i], Bound_Account;
	dispbottom "Purchase complete: " + .@n + " item(s) for " + .@cost + " zeny.";
	end;
}
